commitments.detail: Ensure all participants are aware of the data storage and retention policies.
Provide training on the project guidelines and consent procedures.
Ensure all participants are informed and consented to the project, with a clear understanding of data storage and retention.
Provide consent forms in English only, ensuring transparency and ease of understanding for all involved.
Ensure all participants are from these two grades.
Maintain one adult supervisor for each session.
Use cloud-based storage for recording files.
Retain recordings for 90 days after the exhibit.
Obtain written consent from guardians for participation.
Limit public excerpts to a maximum of 5 minutes.
Consent forms will be available only in English.
Do not provide paper consent forms; use digital alternatives.
Ensure all recordings are stored securely and only accessible to authorized personnel.
Provide clear guidelines and explanations for the project's purpose and procedures.
